hook_options: You're elbows deep in a garbage disposal swap. Phone rings.
The plumber who answers the phone gets the job.
We hear it every day: I can't swap a disposal and answer the phone.
How many disposal replacement calls hit voicemail today?
Every missed disposal call goes straight to the next truck.

If a disposal replacement is worth good money, missing three of those a week adds up fast.
